main.description: Everything the game writes to a player's repo. ⚠ ONE SET, BECAUSE EVERY PERMISSION IS NEEDED TO PLAY; there is no optional feature to split off. A set can grow without anybody re-consenting, which is the point of having one. ⚠ community.lexicon.badge.award IS NOT HERE AND CANNOT BE: HappyView only lets a pet.trezy.* set grant pet.trezy.* collections, so the badge collection is requested as its own repo: scope. ⚠ NO rpc PERMISSIONS, SO NO aud: the client calls HappyView procedures directly, not through PDS service proxying.
main.detail: Look after your pets: adopt them, feed and play with them, collect their coins, and answer Pet of the Week.
main.title: Trezy's Pets
